title: Lake Mead National Park/Colorado Self Guided UTV/Razor Rental
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Arrive at the staging area inside Lake Mead National Park and prepare for a once-in-a-lifetime self-guided RZR adventure to the Colorado River. Set off across miles of naturally formed trails, carving through rugged terrain while taking in the vast desert landscape filled with unique plant life and native wildlife. Feel the freedom to explore at your own pace, as every turn reveals a new breathtaking view.

Ride down 22 miles of naturally formed trails while absorbing the sights of a majestic desert landscape, plants, and wildlife. At the halfway point, you have a photo opportunity at the Colorado River and a quick splash to cool off during the Summer months. After a cool and refreshing splash, head back down the trails of Lake Mead National Park, soak in the scenery one last time before returning with unforgettable memories that will stay with you long after the ride ends."
